title: Marlowe Rewards Member Notice — Tenure Relief on Made-to-Order Work Charges
content:
**Relief.** When a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order Reservation is cancelled in production, Marlowe Rewards tenure relief multiplies the work charge:

- by **0.6** for an active Marlowe Rewards Icon or Atelier member enrolled 36 months or more;
- by **0.8** for an active Marlowe Rewards Gold or Platinum member enrolled 24 months or more;
- by **1.0** for every other customer.

**Records read.** The customer's Marlowe Rewards membership: its status (active or not), the tier it holds, and its enrolment date. Months are counted from the enrolment date to today.

**Where the relief acts.** The relief multiplies the work charge as one more factor of the same product of the reserved price and the work share. It applies before the cap at the deposit held and before the rounding to the cent, both of which apply to the whole product.

**Tier and tenure combinations (hypothetical members)**

| Membership | Months since enrolment | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Active Atelier | 36 | 0.6 |
| Active Icon | 35 | 1.0 |
| Active Platinum | 24 | 0.8 |
| Active Gold | 23 | 1.0 |
| Active Icon | 40 | 0.6 |
| Active Silver | 60 | 1.0 |
| Suspended Gold | 48 | 1.0 |
| No membership | — | 1.0 |

**Points of note**

- Each tier group has its own tenure line: 36 months for Icon and Atelier, 24 months for Gold and Platinum.
- An Icon or Atelier member below 36 months does not fall back to the 24-month line, because that line belongs to the Gold and Platinum tiers. Such a member's work charge is multiplied by 1.0.
- A membership that is not active gives no relief, whatever its tier and tenure.
